- Total oranges: 25
- Bad oranges: 1
- Unripe oranges (20% of total): \(0.2 \times 25 = 5\)
- Sour oranges: 2

- Unripe oranges: 5 (though their exact impact on goodness is unclear without more context)
- Sour oranges: 2

The number of good oranges can be calculated by subtracting the known bad, unripe, and sour oranges from the total:
\[ \text{Good Oranges} = 25 - 1 (\text{bad}) - 0 (\text{sour not necessarily bad}) - 5 (\text{unripe not necessarily bad}) = 19 \]
